tenant.title: Microsoft Entra tenant
tenant.description: Enter your Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) tenant ID or domain (e.g. `contoso.onmicrosoft.com`) if your app registration is single-tenant ("Accounts in this organizational directory only"). Leave the default `common` if it's multi-tenant or supports personal Microsoft accounts.

manual_ids.title: Enter Team and Channel manually
manual_ids.description: We couldn't automatically list your Teams/Channels. You can find the Team ID and Channel ID in the Teams desktop app via the "..." menu on a channel -> Get link to channel; the link contains both IDs.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Microsoft Teams
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant lost access to Microsoft Teams (token expired or consent revoked). Sign in again to restore notifications.

abort.oauth_timeout: Authentication timed out, please try again.
abort.missing_configuration: The integration is not configured. Please follow the documentation.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available. For information about this error, check the help section.
